# Tab

A single tab trigger inside `TabList`, built on react-aria-components `Tab`. The `id` links it to the `TabPanel` with the same `id`. The selected tab shows an accent indicator line and emphasized text; `isDisabled` removes it from selection and keyboard navigation.

Import: `import { Tab } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `Tab`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `Tab` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |

Inherited-but-legal `Tab` props (from the registry `racProps` enumeration): `isDisabled: boolean`, `onPress: (e: PressEvent) => void`. Commonly needed props inherited from the react-aria-components base; the full react-aria-components TabProps surface is also legal.

Theming hooks: `--ds-tabs-*` component-tier tokens (see registries/tokens-index.json); they belong to this component ONLY (NR-008).

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `Tab` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Tab id="billing">Billing</Tab>
<Tab id="danger" isDisabled>Danger zone</Tab>
```
